ev_0006.summary: Figure has labelled vertices A(71.9,688), B(777.3,688), O(424.5,687.7), C(174.5,437.4), D(472.1,98.4). Circle_01 (center ~O, r 352.7) is a visible upper arc from A over the top to B. Segment AB is horizontal and lies on the arc endpoints. OD runs from D down to O and meets AB near O at about 94.6 deg, a candidate perpendicular with no verified mark. OC runs from O to C at 45 deg. Line BC runs from B through C to about (165.5,434.3), which is a short overhang past C. Line D-C continues past C to about (148.4,467.4), which is near unlabeled point_08 (143.4,473.1). Points point_03 (436.1,546.5) and point_07 (453.1,334.5) are genuine intersections: point_03 is OD with line BC, and point_07 is OD with the arc. Right-angle marks at O and C were not verified by detect_right_angle_marker, so no right_angle objects are submitted.
